title: Publisher Concorrente da Outbox e SQS FIFO

proofs.A: Uncommitted transaction event is not visible / published (MVCC)
proofs.B: Publication preserves complete envelope and FIFO attributes (MessageGroupId=aggregateId, MessageDeduplicationId=eventId)
proofs.C: Concurrent claims are disjoint under FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
proofs.D: Pre-send failure recorded with backoff and recovered after lease expiration
proofs.E: Real child process crash after claim: second worker resumes after lease expiration
proofs.F: Real child process crash after SQS confirmation before published_at: recovery republishes with identical eventId without data loss
proofs.G: Obsolete claim token rejected, cannot overwrite new lease
proofs.H: SQS failure schedules backoff with attempts=1 and last_error
proofs.I: Invalid envelope isolated (is_operationally_blocked=true) without blocking batch
proofs.J: NestJS graceful shutdown drains in-flight work and blocks new claims
proofs.K: Financial immutability: zero mutation of balances, versions, transactions, or ledger entries
